brand.name: The Marti School

home.heroBadge: Enrolling now for the {year} school year
home.heroSubtitle: A Saturday school in Maryland where children build fluency in Turkish, connect with their culture, and grow up knowing exactly where they come from.
home.whySubtitle: More than a language class — a community that keeps a heritage alive across generations.
home.why1Body: Every instructor is a fluent Turkish speaker trained in teaching heritage learners, from absolute beginners to children who already speak at home.
home.why2Body: Students are placed by ability, not just age, so nobody is bored and nobody is lost. Placement is reviewed each term.
home.why3Body: Folk dance, music, history and holidays sit alongside reading and writing, because language lives inside a culture.
home.why4Body: Parents get attendance records and detailed termly reports online — real feedback on how their child is actually doing.
home.why5Body: Saturdays only. Serious learning that still leaves room for the rest of family life.
home.why6Body: Families across Maryland who share a language and a heritage, meeting every week and celebrating together.
home.programsSubtitle: From first words to fluent conversation.
home.howSubtitle: Four steps from application to first Saturday.
home.how1Body: Fill in the registration form with your child's details. It takes about five minutes.
home.how2Body: Our principal reviews every application, usually within two to three days.
home.how3Body: Once approved, your child receives a MARTI student ID and login for the parent portal.
home.how4Body: Join your placement class and meet your teacher and classmates.

about.title: About The Marti School
about.subtitle: A weekend school built by Turkish-American families, for Turkish-American children.
about.storyP1: The Marti School began the way most good schools do — with a group of parents worried about something. Their children were growing up in Maryland speaking perfect English and losing the Turkish their grandparents spoke.
about.storyP2: So they started a Saturday class. A handful of families, a borrowed room, and a conviction that a language is worth the effort it takes to keep.
about.storyP3: Today MARTI serves families across Maryland with levelled classes in Turkish language, culture, history and folk arts — still every Saturday, still driven by parents who refuse to let a heritage quietly disappear.
about.missionBody: To give Turkish-American children genuine fluency in their heritage language and a confident, lived connection to their culture — taught well, taken seriously, and rooted in community.
about.value1Body: Turkish is not an extracurricular. It is a family inheritance, and we teach it with the seriousness that deserves.
about.value2Body: Fluent at home or starting from zero — placement by ability means every child has a class where they belong.
about.value3Body: Children learn a culture by living it: dancing it, cooking it, celebrating it, arguing about it.
about.value4Body: This school is run by families. Parents see real progress data and have a real say.
about.teamSubtitle: The people who run the school.
about.joinBody: Whether you want to enroll a child or teach with us, we would like to hear from you.

programs.title: Our programs
programs.subtitle: Levelled classes in language, culture and the arts — every Saturday morning.
programs.ctaBody: Apply and our principal will place your child at the right level after a short conversation.
programs.p1Desc: First words, songs and stories. Play-based Turkish for the youngest learners, with no reading or writing pressure.
programs.p2Desc: The Turkish alphabet, reading, and everyday conversation, alongside games and cultural activities.
programs.p3Desc: Grammar, composition and comprehension, with Turkish history and geography woven through.
programs.p4Desc: Advanced conversation, literature and essay writing. Prepares students for Turkish proficiency exams.
programs.p5Desc: For children who already speak Turkish at home but need reading, writing and formal grammar.
programs.p6Desc: Folk dance, music, traditional crafts and holiday celebrations. Open to every enrolled student.

tuition.title: Tuition & fees
tuition.subtitle: Transparent pricing, with sibling discounts and financial aid available.
tuition.placeholderNotice: Indicative pricing — please confirm current rates with the school office.
tuition.planStandardDesc: One Saturday class per week, all core materials included.
tuition.planFullDesc: Language class plus culture and folk arts — the complete MARTI experience.
tuition.planFamilyDesc: Two or more siblings enrolled, with the full program for each child.
tuition.faq1A: Yes. The second child receives a reduced rate and each additional sibling more so. The Family plan includes this automatically.
tuition.faq2A: Yes. No family is turned away for financial reasons. Contact the school office in confidence to discuss a reduced rate.
tuition.faq3A: Tuition is billed monthly across the school year. Families who prefer to pay the year up front receive a discount.
tuition.faq4A: Tuition is prorated from the month your child starts. Placement is still by ability, so joining later is not a problem.
tuition.faq5A: Optional field trips and the end-of-year festival costume fee are billed separately and always announced in advance.
tuition.faq6Q: Can we try a class first?
tuition.faq6A: Yes. Families are welcome to sit in on one Saturday before committing. Mention it on your registration form.
tuition.ctaBody: Registration takes about five minutes, and there is no payment due until your child is placed.
